meta.tldr:
Cline 4.1.3 focuses heavily on stability and reliability, addressing numerous pain points across the user experience. A critical fix prevents the combined rollout package from invalidating Cline account sessions, eliminating frustrating 'Unauthorized' prompts and unexpected sign-outs, ensuring a smoother authentication experience. Model migration is now more robust, with the system gracefully falling back to a default Cline model if a referenced model ID is unrecognized, preventing unconfigured providers. Checkpoints have been significantly improved, now consistently created and capable of rewinding the entire workspace upon restoration, offering more reliable state management.

Key improvements include better persistence for settings edits, ensuring base URLs, API keys, and API lines are no longer silently discarded before provider config loads. Custom base URL fields are more stable, preventing keystroke loss and preserving checkbox states. The AskSage custom API URL is now correctly utilized during inference. Workflow interruptions are reduced by settling pending tool approvals when messages are edited, preventing tasks from hanging. Attachments are now correctly dropped from edited messages, and terminal commands complete reliably when shell execution ends, avoiding stalls. Commit message generation now includes untracked files, and Windows Store PowerShell profiles run correctly.

Error handling has been enhanced, with upstream provider errors now surfaced instead of generic failures for gateway-forwarded streams. Ollama responses are more resilient, with retries for empty responses and an increased response-start timeout to 5 minutes, mitigating errors from cold model loads. The model picker now displays proper names for Cline free and recommended models, and video input capability is preserved for supported models. Finally, UI polish ensures the plan/act input border correctly syncs with textarea focus. This release is highly recommended for all users to benefit from these stability and reliability enhancements.

features.name: GPT-5.5 Model Support
features.description: Adds support for the GPT-5.5 model for users with an OpenAI Codex subscription.

features.name: Restore VS Code foreground terminal support
features.description: Restores the ability to run cline in the foreground terminal of VS Code, along with associated settings.

features.name: Add latest models
features.description: Adds support for the latest models from OpenAI, SAP AI Core, and Z AI.

features.name: Search & Replace Diff for Large Files
features.description: Cline now uses a search & replace diff based approach when editing large files to prevent code deletion issues.

features.name: Comprehensive Auto-Approve Configuration
features.description: Adds support for a more comprehensive auto-approve configuration, allowing you to specify which tools require approval and which don't.

features.name: System Notifications for Approval and Completion
features.description: Adds ability to enable system notifications for when Cline needs approval or completes a task.

features.name: Root-Level .clinerules File
features.description: Adds support for a root-level `.clinerules` file that can be used to specify custom instructions for the project.

features.name: Block Anchor Matching for Diff Edits
features.description: Adds block anchor matching for more reliable diff edits. If the diff consists of 3 or more lines, the first and last lines are used as anchors to search for the correct location to apply the edit.

features.name: Gemini Model Support
features.description: Adds support for new Gemini models.

features.name: Session Status in CLI History View
features.description: Shows session status in the CLI history view and refreshes status rows in place while the standalone history TUI is open.

features.name: OpenAI Compatible Provider Restore
features.description: Restores the OpenAI compatible provider in the auth flow and preserves stored model metadata when configuring or migrating OpenAI-compatible providers.

features.name: AWS Bedrock Bearer Token Auth
features.description: Accepts bearer token auth for AWS Bedrock and maps AWS profiles correctly when configuring the Bedrock gateway.

features.name: Refined Shared System Prompt
features.description: Refines the shared system prompt with clearer guidance on tool output formatting, unsupported file reads, long-running shell commands, and final verification before completing a task.

features.name: Plugin-Provided Tools in CLI Settings
features.description: Show plugin-provided tools and slash commands in the CLI settings dialog by hydrating them through the sandbox.

features.name: Preserve Hydrated Plugin Tools and Config
features.description: Preserve hydrated plugin tools and config reload options when toggling settings, so they no longer disappear after a toggle.

features.name: SAP AI Core Support for Additional Hosted Models
features.description: Adds support for additional hosted models within SAP AI Core.

features.name: DeepSeek provider for API
features.description: Adds DeepSeek as an available API provider option.

features.name: GPT-5.5 Support for SAP AI Core
features.description: Adds support for GPT-5.5 models when using SAP AI Core as a provider.

features.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro Models
features.description: Adds support for DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro models.

features.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash for Gemini and Vertex Providers
features.description: Adds support for Gemini 3.5 Flash model to both Gemini and Vertex AI providers.

features.name: /lg-task URI Webhook Integration
features.description: Adds `/lg-task` URI webhook integration for LG dashboard flows.

features.name: Claude Opus 4.8 Provider Support
features.description: Adds support for Claude Opus 4.8 provider, including 1M-context variants where available.

features.name: Moonshot Kimi K2.6 Model Support
features.description: Adds Moonshot Kimi K2.6 model support.

features.name: Claude Opus 4.8 Provider Support with 1M Context
features.description: Adds support for Claude Opus 4.8 provider, including variants with a 1 million token context window where available.

features.name: Cline Hub Web App
features.description: Introduces Cline Hub, a web application for monitoring connected clients, viewing and driving sessions, streaming assistant output, and restarting the local hub.
key_details: Supports local, LAN, and tunnel usage.
Access is gated by a room secret.

features.name: Global AGENTS Rules
features.description: Supports global AGENTS rules that apply across all sessions, not just per-project.

features.name: Plugin Rule Contribution
features.description: Allows plugins to contribute static or dynamic rule content when installed in the sandbox.

features.name: Discord Session Binding
features.description: Binds Discord sessions to individual message authors, preventing different Discord users from sharing chat state in a thread.

features.name: Discord Participant Mute Targets
features.description: Supports participant mute targets in Discord, resolving `/mute` and `/unmute` from user mentions or raw user IDs to mute a specific participant in a thread.

features.name: Clickable OAuth URLs in TUI
features.description: Makes OAuth URLs clickable in the TUI.

features.name: SDK Skill Directory Symlink Discovery
features.description: Discovers SDK skill directories that are symlinked, including handling circular symlinks.

features.name: Active Connector Session Steering
features.description: Steers active connector sessions across turn keys by matching on session ID, so replies continue the existing session instead of starting a duplicate.

features.name: Cline Hub Web App
features.description: A web app for monitoring connected clients, viewing and driving sessions, streaming assistant output, and restarting the local hub.
key_details: Supports local, LAN, and tunnel usage.

features.name: System Tray Icon
features.description: A new system tray icon is available, displaying the application's status and the number of active agent sessions.

features.name: Paginated Session History
features.description: Session history is now paginated in ten-session increments, with older history fetched only when the end of the current page is reached.

features.name: Favorite Sessions
features.description: Users can now favorite sessions. Sessions are ordered by most recent activity and display consistent status dot colors across all views.

features.name: Subagent and Teammate Runs in App
features.description: Subagent and teammate runs from a session are now visible within the application, showing their status and results.

features.name: Chat Polish: Tool-Specific Icons
features.description: Tool disclosures in chat now feature tool-specific icons.

features.name: Chat Polish: Elapsed Thinking Time and Restyled Reasoning
features.description: Chat now displays elapsed thinking time and features restyled reasoning sections.

features.name: Chat Polish: Aligned Timestamps
features.description: Timestamps in chat are now aligned for better readability.

features.name: Chat Polish: Message Actions No Longer Shift Layout
features.description: Message actions in chat no longer shift the layout while scrolling remains anchored to the conversation viewport.

features.name: Free Cline Models Support
features.description: Free Cline models are now supported and labeled '(free)' in model pickers, with a clear message, including reset time, when the free-tier limit is reached.

breaking_changes.title: Remove Foreground Terminal Mode
breaking_changes.description: Foreground terminal mode has been removed. All task command execution now defaults to background mode, removing the VS Code integrated terminal dependency and related settings UI.
breaking_changes.migration: No migration is required. All task commands will now execute in the background.
